question (set 3, public): Group our fire claims by the distance to the nearest fire station into bands of 0-5 miles, 6-10 miles, 11-15 miles and more than 15 miles; for each band show the number of claims and the average loss ratio.

question (set 3, public): For each policy coverage period that has at least one claim filed against it, show the policy number, the coverage start date, the premium for that coverage, the incurred loss (loss payments plus loss reserves) on claims filed against it, and the resulting loss ratio.
AI evidence: premium taken as policy amounts with Amount_Type_Code = 'year' (coincides with the premium table on this data); column policy_number holds the internal Policy_Identifier 1
reference SQL: WITH cov_loss AS ( SELECT cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, cc.Effective_Date, SUM(COALESCE(lp.amt,0) + COALESCE(lr.amt,0)) AS incurred_loss FROM main.claim_coverage cc LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amt FROM main.claim_amount ca JOIN main.loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier) lp ON lp.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amt FROM main.claim_amount ca JOIN main.loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier) lr ON lr.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier GROUP BY 1, 2), cov_prem AS ( SELECT Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, Effective_Date, SUM(Policy_Amount) AS premium FROM (SELECT pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier, pa.Policy_Identifier, pa.Effective_Date, pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, pa.Policy_Amount FROM main.policy_amount pa JOIN main.premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier) x GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT p.Policy_Number, pcd.Effective_Date AS coverage_start, cp.premium, cl.incurred_loss, cl.incurred_loss * 1.0 / cp.premium AS loss_ratio FROM cov_loss cl JOIN main.policy_coverage_detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cl.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier AND pcd.Effective_Date = cl.Effective_Date JOIN main.policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier JOIN cov_prem cp ON cp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cl.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier AND cp.Effective_Date = cl.Effective_Date ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, coverage_start
answer SQL:
WITH claims AS (
  SELECT cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, cc.Effective_Date, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier) AS claim_count
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage" cc
  GROUP BY cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, cc.Effective_Date
),
loss_ids AS (
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment"
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve"
),
cov_claims AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, Effective_Date, Claim_Identifier
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage"
),
losses AS (
  SELECT c.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, c.Effective_Date, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
  FROM cov_claims c
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN loss_ids li ON li.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY c.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, c.Effective_Date
),
premiums AS (
  SELECT pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, pa.Effective_Date, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" pa
  WHERE LOWER(pa.Amount_Type_Code) = 'year'
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, pa.Effective_Date
)
SELECT
  pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
  pcd.Policy_Identifier AS policy_number,
  pcd.Effective_Date AS coverage_start_date,
  p.premium,
  COALESCE(l.incurred_loss, 0) AS incurred_loss,
  COALESCE(l.incurred_loss, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.premium, 0) AS loss_ratio,
  cl.claim_count
FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" pcd
JOIN claims cl
  ON cl.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND cl.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
LEFT JOIN losses l
  ON l.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND l.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
LEFT JOIN premiums p
  ON p.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND p.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
WHERE cl.claim_count >= 1
ORDER BY pcd.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Effective_Date, pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LIMIT 500

reference SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 5 THEN '0-5 miles' WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 10 THEN '6-10 miles' WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 15 THEN '11-15 miles' ELSE 'more than 15 miles' END AS distance_band, COUNT(*) AS claims, AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS avg_loss_ratio FROM main.fire_claim GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(Nearest_Firestation_miles)
answer SQL:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '0-5 miles'
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 miles'
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '11-15 miles'
        ELSE 'More than 15 miles'
    END AS distance_band,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_claims,
    AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM acme_insurance.main.fire_claim
WHERE Nearest_Firestation_miles >= 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY MIN(
    CASE
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 5 THEN 1
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 10 THEN 2
        WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 15 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END
)
LIMIT 501

question (set 3, public): For each policy, how many days passed between the end of its underwriting assessment and the policy's effective date, and who was the underwriter (first and last name) and what was the assessment result?
AI evidence: "for each policy": Policy_Identifier instead of Policy_Number; names and result present
reference SQL: SELECT p.Policy_Number, pe.First_Name, pe.Last_Name, ar.Assessment_Result_Type_Code, date_diff('day', a.End_Date, p.Effective_Date) AS days_assessment_end_to_effective FROM main.policy p JOIN main.agreement_assessment aa ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier JOIN main.assessment a ON a.Assessment_Identifier = aa.Assessment_Identifier JOIN main.assessment_result ar ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier JOIN main.underwriting_assessment ua ON ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier = ar.Assessment_Result_Identifier JOIN main.assesment_party_role apr ON apr.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier JOIN main.party_role r ON r.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code JOIN main.person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier WHERE r.Party_Role_Name = 'Underwriter' ORDER BY p.Policy_Number
answer SQL:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    date_diff('day', a.End_Date, p.Effective_Date) AS Days_To_Policy_Effective_Date,
    pe.First_Name AS Underwriter_First_Name,
    pe.Last_Name AS Underwriter_Last_Name,
    ar.Assessment_Result_Type_Code AS Assessment_Result
FROM policy AS p
LEFT JOIN agreement_assessment AS aa
    ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN assessment AS a
    ON a.Assessment_Identifier = aa.Assessment_Identifier
LEFT JOIN assesment_party_role AS apr
    ON apr.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
    AND (
        apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%underwriter%'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM party_role AS pr
            WHERE pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
              AND pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%underwriter%'
        )
    )
LEFT JOIN person AS pe
    ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN assessment_result AS ar
    ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
LEFT JOIN underwriting_assessment AS ua
    ON ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier = ar.Assessment_Result_Identifier
WHERE ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier IS NOT NULL;

question (set 3, public): For each claim, what is the ratio of total amounts paid (loss payments plus expense payments) to total amounts reserved (loss reserves plus expense reserves)?
AI evidence: "for each claim": surrogate Claim_Identifier instead of Company_Claim_Number, same two claims
reference SQL: SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, (COALESCE(lp.amt,0) + COALESCE(ep.amt,0)) * 1.0 / (COALESCE(lr.amt,0) + COALESCE(er.amt,0)) AS paid_to_reserved_ratio FROM main.claim c LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amt FROM main.claim_amount ca JOIN main.loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier) lp ON lp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amt FROM main.claim_amount ca JOIN main.loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier) lr ON lr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amt FROM main.claim_amount ca JOIN main.expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier) ep ON ep.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier LEFT JOIN (SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amt FROM main.claim_amount ca JOIN main.expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier) er ON er.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number
answer SQL:
WITH categorized_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)
      + SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_payment" ep WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)
      + SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_reserve" er WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_reserved
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  Claim_Identifier,
  total_paid / NULLIF(total_reserved, 0) AS paid_to_reserved_ratio
FROM categorized_amounts
LIMIT 501
